texts.name: Anakis
texts.biography: With the rebuilding of the Technology Guild, Anakis finally proved his skill at controlling cyborgs, making him a better general.

specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Magnetic Cyborgs or Nuclear Cyborgs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 6 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Magnetic Cyborgs
